decision: Reject adoption of Gemini 3.8 Flash; DeepSeek Flash1017 remains deployed; Haiku 5.5 and MiniMax M3.1 Flash unqualified (not played)

conform001.note: 3 attempts held after conform001 and used by conform002 (Vertex)

selection.basis: Lead scoring against frozen labels: Gemini captured every decisive fact in D2/D4/P1/P2 with no decisive contradiction and stayed within 220 words; Haiku denied supported D4 avatar travel (the same decisive miss as DeepSeek/Qwen) and exceeded 220 words in all four; MiniMax misidentified the D4 avatar, attributed a historical door message to UP, and treated the P1 selection preview as changed carried load. Published priors: Google recommends Gemini 3.8 Flash for computer use; Haiku 5.5 reports OSWorld 2.1 subset 72.4%. Conformance: all three passed; Gemini slowest (short 3.5 s, long 7.4 s, continuation 6.4 s) but within the same range.
selection.limits: One answer per cell; D2/D4 previously exposed to other models; P1/P2 share one world. Not a comparable game score or model-superiority claim. Actual play decides adoption.

independent_scoring.reviewer: clean-context agent reviewer (not human), labels and answers only
independent_scoring.gemini: all decisive facts in D4 and P1; within 220 words on all four; small overclaims (NPC adjacency/position, unseen P2 clock after i, D2 "no physical world interactions", missed D2 camera pan)
independent_scoring.haiku: most careful about unknowns, no traps; under-claims decisive D4 northward step and P1 cancellation; over 220 words on all four
independent_scoring.minimax: invented shelf items and weights, wrong clock, historical log lines read as new events, inconsistent avatar identity; over 220 words on all four
independent_scoring.agreement: matches the lead ranking and the selection

accounting.actual_cost_note: Host traces carry configured-rate costs only; gameplay cost from OpenRouter key/account usage readings; account shared beyond this project, so deltas may include unrelated spend.

monitoring: read-only 15 s checks; max gap 15.03 s; no 45 s deviations
retention: Only allowlisted summaries and three original PNGs are published. Packages, answers, labels, traces and saves remain ignored project-local evidence. No private reasoning, raw request bodies, credentials or local paths are included.

assessments.play002: not separately assessed (36 attempts, ended on HTTP 503)

deviation: All three admissions went to Gemini (third on google-vertex/global) after two external stops; the frozen alternate (Haiku) received no gameplay, so the rejection rests on one model.
